sections.title: Reading — Task 1: Tasks
sections.instructions: Read the passage, then answer the questions.

questions.prompt: The two maps below show an island, before and after the construction of some tourist facilities. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.

Some people believe that universities should only offer places to students with high marks, while others believe that people of all ages should be allowed even if they don't do well in school. Discuss both views and give your opinion. Write at least 250 words. Cambridge IELTS Tests 1 to 17
